coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: The output identifies EM and MinED as the criteria being compared, matching one of the three ground-truth variable items (33%).
coverage.design_error_analysis: The output does not specify BBH as the fixed benchmark or average score across all 27 BBH tasks as the dependent variable. Instead, it focuses on reward-formulation refinements, thresholds, and synthetic sanity checks. References to omitted sections do not establish the missing variables.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty and therefore does not semantically match the ground-truth conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: The output fails to state that minimum-edit-distance-based MinED consistently outperforms the exact-matching EM method introduced by Fu et al. (2023).
